description: An airport's live departure or arrival board for passenger flights: times, delay, status, terminal and gate, from an hour ago on for today, with the current weather. Covers the Taiwan airports. Example: airport "TSA", direction "departures", otherAirport "金門".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

airline.description: Only this airline, IATA code, e.g. "BR".

airport.description: The Taiwan airport: IATA code (TPE, TSA, KHH, KNH) or name (松山, 金門, Hualien).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

limit.description: Maximum number of flights to return (default 20).

otherAirport.description: Only flights to (or, for arrivals, from) this airport: IATA code or name.

name: flight_board
title: Airport departures and arrivals
